description: Check whether a full-time, part-time or casual worker in Ireland is entitled to a public holiday and what they are owed (the 40-hours-in-5-weeks rule, a day's pay, or one fifth of weekly pay).

days_per_week.description: Days normally worked a week. Default 5

employment.description: full_time, or part_time for part-time and casual workers

falls_on_working_day.description: true if the holiday falls on a day they normally work

hours_last_5_weeks.description: Part-time only: hours worked for the employer in the 5 weeks before the holiday (annual leave counts)

weekly_pay.description: Normal weekly pay in EUR (if hours vary, the average over the 13 weeks before the holiday, without overtime)

name: public_holiday_pay_ireland
title: Public holiday pay (Ireland)
